definitions.gloss: to sit down, to take a seat
definitions.explanation: To sit on a chair, bench, or other raised surface. Unlike 座る which covers sitting on the floor or any sitting posture, 腰掛ける specifically implies sitting on something with a seat — a chair, bench, edge, or similar surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧た。
examples.english: I sat down on the bench.

examples.japanese: ⟦どうぞ→どうぞ：02920_douzo⟧⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧て⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。

⟦{窓辺|まどべ}→窓辺：20444_madobe⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧て⟦{外|そと}→外：00671_soto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{景色|けしき}→景色：01395_keshiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{眺|なが}めていた→眺める：02132_nagameru⟧。
examples.english: I was sitting in a chair by the window, gazing at the scenery outside.

notes:
USAGE:
{腰掛|こしか}ける means to sit on a raised surface (chair, bench, edge of a bed, etc.). The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the surface sat on. It differs from ⟦{座|すわ}る→座る：00757_suwaru⟧, which is the general word for sitting and can include sitting on the floor or in any position.

Conjugation: ichidan verb (⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / ⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧ます / ⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧て).

The related noun ⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧ means a stool or temporary seat, and figuratively refers to a temporary job or position (⟦{腰掛|こしか}け→腰掛け：15323_koshikake⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{椅子|いす}→椅子：00706_isu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腰掛|こしか}ける: to sit in a chair
- ⟦ベンチ→ベンチ：00013_benchi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腰掛|こしか}ける: to sit on a bench
- ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腰掛|こしか}ける: to sit on the veranda
